text:
jess: Heads up — after morning maintenance we bumped NCCL to 2.25.1 across us-west4 GPU pools. Seeing sporadic inference hangs on mixed A100/H100 nodes, ~0.5–2% of requests. Logs show collective timeouts and p2p errors.

miguel: Can you paste the recent failure log snippet?

jess: Sure, here's a representative error from the serving runtime:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] RPC worker 12: allreduce failed: NCCL WARN Call to cuDevicePrimaryCtxGetState failed, ncclcomm.c:212
[2026-03-18T09:12:03Z] collective timeout after 120s, group 0x7f8a... fallback triggered
```

raj: Interesting — we also rolled drivers to 535.86 on that fleet yesterday and CUDA 12.3 kernels. Mixed-arch (A100+H100) NVLINK topology can expose p2p handshake flakiness with 2.25.x.

elaine: Observed increased tail latency on us-west4-inference-prod: p95 up from 180ms -> 420ms. Pod concurrency drops because requests stall waiting on KV cache flushes.

runtime-bot: Incident alert: collective_timeout threshold crossed in us-west4 (5m window). Triggered autoscale policy suspension.

miguel: Quick triage suggestions:
- try NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 on a canary subset (forces socket fallbacks) to see if hangs disappear
- enable NCCL_DEBUG=INFO on the runtime to get handshake traces

jess: Ran canary with NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 on 4 nodes — no hangs in 20m, tail latencies normalized. Reverting to that for affected pool now.

ops-oncall: What's the rollback plan for the rest of us-west4? Rolling back drivers is expensive.

raj: Short-term: set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 and pin NCCL to 2.24.9 for full fleet rollback if needed. Long-term: reproduce in lab with mixed-arch topology + 535.86 driver and file an upstream bug with vendor logs.

elaine: I'll open a postmortem ticket and document cost impact: we estimate 8% throughput loss while investigating and risk of higher token cost.

miguel: Command we used to patch canary:
```
kubectl set env ds/inference-runtime -n us-west4 NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 --record
# then patch daemonset image: inference-runtime:v1.24-canary
```

jess: Adding action items:
- raj to repro in staging with perf harness (ETA 6h)
- miguel to roll NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 to the rest of us-west4 (in progress)
- elaine to quantify cost/latency delta and create customer comms draft
- ops-oncall to monitor for regressions and prepare rollback playbook

sre-luca: Suggest collecting `nvidia-smi topo -m` and `dmesg | tail` from a failing host for the ticket.

jess: Thanks — will attach logs to the bug and post updates here. :pray:
